subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool as the permanent append contract, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The source-reproducible problem is real, but the remaining fix is a public model-facing and extension-observable tool contract that automation should not choose without maintainer API intent.

options.title: Accept append flag on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after resolving conflicts and review, keeping overwrite as default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose another append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code change
options.body: Keep relying on backup or `exec >>` workarounds while accepting that ordinary write calls can still truncate shared files.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after resolving conflicts and review, keeping overwrite as default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the shared model-facing write-tool contract, and steipete is the strongest current history signal for that runtime surface.
